content.intro: This lesson introduces database and external service reliability as part of professional python development and deployment. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: External systems fail or return unexpected data. Validate responses, use parameterized queries, set timeouts, manage transactions, and avoid exposing credentials.

content_blocks.code:
import sqlite3

with sqlite3.connect(":memory:") as connection:
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE task (name TEXT)")
    connection.execute("INSERT INTO task VALUES (?)", ("Study Python",))
    row = connection.execute("SELECT name FROM task").fetchone()
    print(row[0])
